title: Diet Drinks or Water? A Two-Year Weight Study
paragraphs: Many people want to lose weight. Some drink water. Some drink diet drinks with no sugar.
Scientists in England did a study for two years. 493 people were in it. Some drank water. Some drank diet drinks.
Both groups lost weight. The diet drink group lost 4.8 kilos. The water group lost 3.7 kilos. Scientists say this is about the same.
